exophase.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

psnprofiles.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops on its own once the other 54 are earned — there is no extra task. Single-player only; no multiplayer or DLC is needed. Plan on roughly 200 hours in total (PowerPyx's estimate).

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy. It unlocks when you finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1. Just play the story — it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 1. PowerPyx notes it pops after the first main mission of Chapter 2, 'What's in the Bag?'. Automatic; cannot be missed.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 2. It pops after the first main mission of Chapter 3, 'Welcome to Vice City'. Automatic; cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 3. It pops after the first two main missions of Chapter 4, 'Ocean Beach' and 'Another Life'. Automatic; cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 4. It pops after the final main mission of Chapter 4, 'Starting From Zero'. Automatic; cannot be missed.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the final mission. PowerPyx puts it at the same Chapter 4 finale, 'Starting From Zero'. Finish the story and it pops; it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run. Play the story and it unlocks during that mission; it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the Chapter 3 mission The Cartel Heist. It unlocks during that mission; it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the Chapter 4 mission Child's Play. It unlocks during that mission; it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the Chapter 4 mission Headliners. It unlocks during that mission; it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the Chapter 4 mission VCIA Takedown. It unlocks during that mission; it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the Chapter 5 mission Operation Savage Glory. It unlocks during that mission; it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The 100% checklist opens after the story under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, and anything you did during the story already counts toward it. The bar is forgiving — PowerPyx puts it near 60% of true completion: you need any 100 optional missions, any 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, any 100 of 255 animals studied, 300 stunts, and 70 of 80 challenges. Nothing toward 100% is missable; everything stays doable in free-roam after the story.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off any 250 of the 397 stunts — you can mix the four kinds: 130 stunt jumps over ramps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights between buildings, and 25 base jumps. Under-the-bridge flights are the quickest. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going after this pops. Track progress under Progress > Activities > Stunts, and see each stunt by name on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Do each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race / race challenge / drone race, and performing a stunt. Check your count under Touchpad > Progress > Activities. Most come on their own from the story and other trophies, so don't chase this one early.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 shooting range challenges, spread over 12 range locations. The medals are not too hard, per PowerPyx, and the 100% checklist needs every range done too.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations (42 drone races in total across them). One win per location is enough.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. There are 40 unique race locations, so pick the ones you like and skip the rest.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission 'Feng Shui', where you meet Cal, he texts you a fishing spot (purple map icon). Follow his fishing questline and beat him in a challenge.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish any one of the four arcade games — Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind, or Bang For Your Buck. The first three are on the TV at home (use the controllers) from Chapter 1; Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines around the world. 'Complete' means reaching the end of all its levels once; you don't need every challenge.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's questline, Lucia only. It gets marked automatically in Chapter 3 — Andy calls, then texts her home address in Belville. Finish her five quests: the three-part 'Climbing the Cellerichain', 'Pay the Cellerica Fee', 'Peach!', 'Read the Label', and 'Puff Puff Pass'. All of it stays available after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's questline, marked automatically in Chapter 1. After the mission 'Island Dreams', he calls and gets a green 'KR' icon in Key Lento. He sends you treasure-diving at 7 shipwrecks — find the chests with the metal detector on the ocean floor and bring them back. Track it under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees. He goes quiet after Chapter 1 but comes back in Chapters 2-3 (calling Brian as Jason in Chapter 2 speeds it up), so nothing here is missable.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's questline, marked after the Chapter 2 mission 'Coffee Break', at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Finish his five jobs: 'Thrillbillies', 'Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab', 'Mall Rats', 'The Impaler' (steal the Impaler), and 'Hometown Heroes'. All available after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 stranger mission strands. Only some questlines count — Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not. Confirmed counters include Kirk's Skunk Ape hunts, Kyle's farm jobs, Yago's street races, and Pilot Pete's deliveries; PowerPyx says more are still being found. They all stay available in free-roam after the story, and the trophy tracker shows your count.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's 'Wish List', marked after the Chapter 3 mission 'Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS' (stealing the Zorrusso also unlocks the Key Cloner). Deliver the 16 sports cars he wants — the Zorrusso is handed over during the story; the rest (Vitello, Infernus, Windsor Drop, Toros, Tempesta, Paragon, Jagular, Jubilee, Itali RSX, Growler, Gauntlet Hellfire, Furia, Dubsta, Banshee, Baller ST-D) can be stolen off the street anywhere, and scanning a car with WAiNK tells you if it's on the list. Track it under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List; Randy is the green 'RK' icon in west Vice City. Deliver in good condition for more money.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's questline, Jason only, marked after the Chapter 3 mission 'Here, Kitty Kitty'. Purple markers show Synthetic Labs around Vice City — destroy enough of them in 'Take Out Kitty Litter' and Tyrone hands you the second quest, 'Spin On This', which pops the trophy when you shut the labs down. Still available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations; meditating with both Jason and Lucia at the same spot counts twice. Track it under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. POTENTIALLY MISSABLE: the first meditation, at Jason's house in Chapter 1, is only available that chapter — after the mission 'Down to Earth', talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony when she says she'll meditate, and choose 'Accept'. PowerPyx warns it raises the counter but isn't marked as a spot, so it isn't yet clear whether it's required; for the 100% checklist only 15 of 18 are needed. You can't finish the last spots until both characters can play together (after Chapter 2's 'Coffee Break'). Keep a manual save at the start of Chapter 1 just in case.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's questline, Jason only. After the Chapter 2 mission 'Coffee Break', Bret texts you; his first quest 'Veteran Hunted' is in Lummox County. Hunt the animals he requests and bring them to him as Jason. His first quest hands you the unique rifle 'Killtelligence SM-69' (collect it from any Ammu-Nation weapon locker); one clean shot keeps the animal pristine and pays more, but isn't required. Track the hunts under Map > Activities > Target Deck — there are 15 decks, and all 15 are needed for the 100% checklist anyway. PowerPyx notes it isn't yet confirmed exactly which animal pops the trophy.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. There are 18 card set locations in total, so you only need three of them.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan any 100 spots with WAiNK (hold Up, then R1): 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures are known, and there are more than 100 scannable spots in total, so any 100 will do.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. The 100% checklist needs 70 of 80, so this pops on the way there. Track them under Progress > Challenges, and leave the hardest ones for last — there are 10 more challenges than the checklist needs.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you. It opens after Chapter 2's 'Coffee Break', when you can free-roam together — call your partner with hold Right + Triangle. Build 4 stars, then escape: a fast sports motorcycle helps, and PowerPyx's easiest route is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where cops struggle on the tracks and the helicopter can't see you. The trophy pops once you're out of the red heat zone. It also comes on its own during the Chapter 4 optional mission 'That's Where The Money Is…' and the bank vault robberies, which always trigger 4 stars.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner while keeping your wanted level the whole time. It opens after Chapter 2's 'Coffee Break'. Hit 3 robbery targets (green map icons) in a row without the wanted level dropping — keep the flashing red/blue wanted state, not the solid red heat state. Bring an armored vest and sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation, plus Zombix or Adrenaline for healing. The pop is delayed about 30 seconds after you leave the third shop; if it doesn't come, hit a fourth. A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City, open after Chapter 3's 'Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs' — loot a couple of items in each and break the back-room safe with sticky bombs.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. The fastest way is the WAiNK app (hold Up on the phone): stand on a busy road and scan passing cars — scanning is enough, you don't have to drive them. There are 557 vehicles at launch, and the 100% checklist wants 200 base models scanned, so this pops early. Track totals under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Drop 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus (L3+R3 while aiming — time slows and weak spots light up; it drains the purple focus bar, so it only lasts a few seconds). Buff your focus first with food, drinks, or a wash/shower at home, and pop Adrenaline (hold L1, then Triangle) to stretch the time. Line up 5 enemies — the criminals at gang operations work — and use an assault rifle like the Duke 556; body armor from Ammu-Nation helps you stand your ground. It doesn't count on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels (Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Focus); shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots raise it, and by Focus Level 4 this usually comes naturally.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked to a departure terminal at VCIA — it has to be one hooked to a passenger boarding bridge, not the planes parked on the airfield. The easiest is at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence, take the stairs by the boarding bridge straight into the plane (or walk in through the terminal), go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse onto the airstrip and take off. Fly 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport and the trophy pops — it's slightly delayed.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank from Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. The tanks stand in the south of the base — drive through the gate or use the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, climb in and shoot until it pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being spotted. First finish Chapter 3's 'Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs' — it unlocks the Snap Gun, which silently lockpicks alarmed doors, and marks jewelry robberies with green icons. Slip in through the back door with the Snap Gun (it's always in your inventory; kicking the door sets the alarm off), find the note with the safe code in the back room, and loot the safe. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good first target.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. It opens with the Chapter 4 optional mission 'That's Where The Money Is…' (wait at the cafe): tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the guard opens the vault, and bring your partner — hold Right to hand off a bag, since you can't carry it all. After that, pay the fence Yasmani for security-van tips ($10,000, after his earlier Payday Loans jobs) and the vans show as purple icons. Every vault robbery triggers a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast motorcycle and switch cars to shake the heat. There are 8 large bank jobs; 5 pop the trophy, all 8 are needed for 100%, and a vault can pay up to $205,000.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. It comes free with the Chapter 4 optional mission 'That's Where The Money Is…' — a bank vault robbery counts as an armored truck robbery. To get it earlier, block an armored truck driving near a bank in Vice City, stick a bomb on its back door and blow it open, then escape the red heat radius. Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop once you've done his quests.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida — fully unfog the map. A plane is the fastest way: fly over every black-fogged patch until the whole map is visible.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 operations in total — one per gang pops the trophy, but the 100% checklist wants all 39. They show as yellow icons when you're near them, and many get marked by the story. Track each gang under Progress > Gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Not yet known — PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, so no guide can pin it down yet. The description says to enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach, so the honest play is to visit a bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and take in the view; check back for an update once a guide confirms the exact spot.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Not yet known — PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown. The description points to smashing your way out of a vehicle showroom 'in classic style', which reads like a robbery or story beat in a showroom; until a guide confirms the exact trigger, treat it as one to watch for while doing vehicle robberies and story missions.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the gang operations: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun 'Gutterball Moreland 850' on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway office (blow it with sticky bombs — buy them at Ammu-Nation first). It opens during the Chapter 2 optional mission 'Hit Kingpin Bowling'. The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you grab the third item — and it isn't missable: the robbery icon respawns after a while, so you can come back for anything you missed.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. It opens after Chapter 2's 'Coffee Break', when you can switch characters. Work out at a fitness club — buy a membership, filter clubs on Map > Activities — and always bring your partner (hold Right + Triangle to call them): while one of you trains, the other completes their training automatically, so you progress twice as fast. You can also work out at home after the story. Check strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Do 500 things that move your criminal profile — PSN tracks the count (0/500). Turn on the notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On) and a small demon face appears whenever an action counts. The profile runs Professional (stealthy objectives, destroying evidence, clean escapes), Hardened (incapacitating without killing), Violent (killing enemies and civilians), Psycho (killing many cops and civilians, driving over gravestones), and Irredeemable (permanent, from excessive violence — avoid it, since cops then shoot on sight). It builds passively through robberies and fights, so most players get it without trying; if you're short at the end, running over civilians and cops with a car farms it fast.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Not yet known — PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue. Until a guide confirms it, the honest advice is to visit the Payday Loans store and try its interactions; 'second time's the charm' hints at succeeding on a second attempt at something.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Not yet known — PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to come from a UFO questline. Until a guide confirms the exact trigger, keep an eye out for strange lights and UFO-related encounters in free-roam; 'what the hell just happened?' suggests a one-off strange event.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Not yet known — PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to come from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle. Until a guide confirms it, the play is to try melee kicks from a moving bike at enemies; 'bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by' points at knocking someone down that way.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of marked bills through your contacts. First finish the Chapter 3 mission 'Credit Check' (meet Raul's crew) to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer, then rob banks and Payday Loans and carry the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The $250,000 is cumulative across robberies, not one trip; bank vaults alone can pay up to $205,000 each once they're open (after Chapter 4's 'That's Where The Money Is…'), so it comes naturally with the robbery trophies.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the priciest, so they're the fastest way there. The island has 24 Ammu-Nations, 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair and beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores — any spending counts.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages (there are 4 more from the story, which don't count). They cost $160,000 in total and go on sale after the Chapter 2 mission 'Daily Driver' — your phone gets the Vice City Real Estate app and you buy them through it. Robberies, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3-4, are the quickest way to fund them.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. The app arrives after the Chapter 2 mission 'Moses' — it lets you call registered stolen vehicles to you anywhere. You'll need enough garages first (see Little Boxes), since each garage adds parking spots. Drive a stolen car to Moses in Port Gellhorn, and in his garage choose 'Respray' then 'Register'. At first he only takes cars without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap cars and bikes.
